description: A self-contained Pac-Man-style maze game with pellets, power pills, frightened ghosts, score, lives, and high score.

panels.description: Self-contained Pac-Man game. The controls are displayed below the board so they never cover the maze; focus the board, use arrows or WASD to move, and Space to restart.
